candidates.name: IOCTL_VOLUME_GET_VOLUME_DISK_EXTENTS
verified_facts: Returns the physical disk extents that compose an open volume.
semantic_limits: Spanned or dynamic volumes can require multiple extents and buffer-resize handling.

candidates.name: VOLUME_DISK_EXTENTS
verified_facts: Carries an extent count and variable array of physical disk extents for a volume.
semantic_limits: The variable-length array requires overflow and count validation before dereference.

candidates.name: DISK_EXTENT
verified_facts: Defines a disk number, starting offset, and extent length within a volume mapping.
semantic_limits: Extent coordinates are layout metadata and can change after storage reconfiguration.

candidates.name: IOCTL_DISK_GET_DRIVE_GEOMETRY_EX
verified_facts: Returns extended disk geometry, disk size, partition style, and detection information.
semantic_limits: Reported geometry can be virtualized and must not be treated as immutable hardware identity.

candidates.name: DISK_GEOMETRY_EX
verified_facts: Carries basic geometry, total disk size, and variable partition and detection data.
semantic_limits: Variable trailing data requires structure-version and buffer-bound validation.

candidates.name: DISK_GEOMETRY
verified_facts: Carries cylinders, media type, tracks, sectors, and bytes per sector.
semantic_limits: Legacy geometry can be translated or synthetic and is not a precise physical-layout guarantee.

candidates.name: DISK_PARTITION_INFO
verified_facts: Carries MBR signature or GPT disk identifier information in extended geometry output.
semantic_limits: Partition-style identity must be correlated with drive-layout and exact disk-handle evidence.

candidates.name: IOCTL_DISK_GET_DRIVE_LAYOUT_EX
verified_facts: Returns extended partition-table information for MBR and GPT disks.
semantic_limits: Drive layout is a mutable snapshot and does not prove a volume still maps to the same partition later.

candidates.name: DRIVE_LAYOUT_INFORMATION_EX
verified_facts: Carries partition style, partition count, style-specific disk data, and partition entries.
semantic_limits: Partition count and variable entries require size, style, and bounds validation.

candidates.name: PARTITION_INFORMATION_EX
verified_facts: Carries partition style, start offset, length, number, rewrite flag, and MBR or GPT data.
semantic_limits: Partition metadata is not file identity and can change through administrative storage operations.

candidates.name: IOCTL_DISK_GET_LENGTH_INFO
verified_facts: Returns the length in bytes of a disk, partition, or volume handle.
semantic_limits: Length alone cannot distinguish devices or prove geometry, health, or content.

candidates.name: IOCTL_DISK_GET_DISK_ATTRIBUTES
verified_facts: Returns current disk attributes such as offline and read-only state.
semantic_limits: Disk attributes are mutable policy state and do not prove receipt or runner identity.

candidates.name: GetVolumePathNamesForVolumeNameW
verified_facts: Returns all drive letters and mounted-folder paths associated with a volume GUID path.
semantic_limits: Mount paths can change and require a double-null-terminated buffer and canonical volume correlation.

candidates.name: FindFirstVolumeW
verified_facts: Starts enumeration of volume GUID paths present on the computer.
semantic_limits: Enumeration order has no relationship to BIOS order, drive letters, or canonical task ownership.

candidates.name: FindNextVolumeW
verified_facts: Continues volume GUID enumeration one volume at a time until ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES.
semantic_limits: The search is a snapshot-like enumeration and must be closed and correlated with path and device mappings.
